messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: service=inference-prod region=us-west-2 metric=p99_latency value=1.9s threshold=1.2s — automated paging to #eng-sre :rotating_light:
maria (oncall): picking this up, oncall here. seeing spike started ~6894320900 according to dashboards.
ajay: confirm — p95 around 700ms but p99 > 1.8s for streaming endpoints, affects streaming and non-streaming decode paths.
maria (oncall): any recent rollouts? infra/deploys in last hour?
deploy-bot: deploys: runtime-service v2026.03.14 (trt-upgrade + kernel-linker v2.1.0) rolled at 6889998000 by @ci/cd, no failed jobs reported.
ajay: that runtime change included new compile flags and FlashAttention v3 enablement on the small subset — I suspect kernel/compilepath regression.
sam: logs show a tail of heavy memcpy and occasional pagewalks on a subset of pods — likely kernel path that interacts poorly w/ TRT8 changes. attaching quick snippet: ```
[decoder][WARN] kv-cache-evict count=1249 latency_ms=1234
[sys] pagefaults=37 cgroup=runtime-42 kernel_module=kernel-linker-2.1.0
```
elaine: customer-impact: alerting SRE dashboard shows ~2.1% of requests exceed p99 SLA, top impacted customer tenants: acme-corp, beta-queue-3. CS already received two tickets.
maria (oncall): OK mitigation plan options: 1) rollback kernel-linker to v2.0.8 2) disable flashattn v3 flag 3) route traffic away from affected GPU pool to legacy-pool. prefer 1+3 short-term.
ajay: agree. rollback kernel-linker quick path available: rtxctl kernel rollback --service runtime-service --to=2.0.8. But there is known warmup cost ~30s per pod.
sam: meanwhile we can reduce batch size for streaming to lower memory pressure: set ENV BATCH_MAX=1 on affected deployment.
maria (oncall): executing rollback now. running: ```
rtxctl kernel rollback --service runtime-service --to=2.0.8 --region us-west-2 --force-checks=false
```
deploy-bot: initiated rollback job job_id=rb-6894321 by maria (oncall). estimated duration 4m.
devops: also patching routing to move 20% traffic off pool-gpu-a to legacy-pool-gpu: ```
kubectl patch svc routing-service -n prod --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic","value":{"legacy-pool":0.2,"pool-gpu-a":0.8}}]'
```
sam: rolling config change applied, verifying.
aila (infra-checker): health checks: some pods in runtime-service reported OOMKills during the spike window; related to new allocator behavior in kernel-linker v2.1.0.
ajay: note — if rollback doesn't bring p99 down in 10m, fallback = disable flashattn entirely: set runtime flag FLASHATTN_ENABLED=false and restart workers.
maria (oncall): rollback finished according to deploy-bot: job rb-6894321 SUCCESS, new kernel-linker on runtime-service = 2.0.8.
deploy-bot: rollout complete, restarted 42 pods, avg restart 28s.
sam: I'm seeing p99 drop to ~1.05s immediately for most pods, p95 stable at ~620ms. still a few stragglers with >1.5s — likely warmup.
elaine: customer-impact update: tickets triaged, outreach in progress; notifying PLs for acme-corp and beta-queue-3.
ajay: runtime metrics snapshot after rollback: ```
region=us-west-2 p95=630ms p99=1.07s error_rate=0.03% streaming_tail=spike->damped
```
maria (oncall): good. I'm going to leave temp routing in place for 30m and monitor. sam, can you take handoff for next 2h to watch for regressions and follow up with eng-runtime? I'll open postmortem.
sam: taking handoff. created tracking ticket INF-7219, assigning to eng-runtime + eng-sre. will collect traces and heap dumps from impacted pods.
maria (oncall): action items captured: 1) eng-runtime to revert/troubleshoot compile flags introduced in v2.1.0, check -fno-simd vs new linker behavior 2) ML infra to run perf regression harness on TRT8+FlashAttention v3 combos 3) SRE to keep routing til p99 stable <1.2s for 1h 4) postmortem draft by EOD.
sam: quick mitigation playbook (for runbook): ```
- If p99 > 1.2s and linked to kernel-linker: rtxctl kernel rollback --to=2.0.8
- If rollback fails or rollout blocked: set FLASHATTN_ENABLED=false and restart runtime-service pods
- If customers impacted >1%: route 20-50% traffic to legacy-pool and notify CS
```
elaine: adding CS communications template to ticket.
maria (oncall): marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. handoff to sam for monitoring and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
sam: acknowledged. will post updates in INF-7219 and ping eng-runtime leads.
deploy-bot: noted rollback cadence and preserved logs at s3://redwood-incidents/6894321000/
incident-bot: Incident closed alert suppressed until postmortem completed.
